C-CALIBRATION.Summary: Record self-reported confidence so it can be studied, consume it nowhere, and build the calibration report without which the field is pure token tax (D6). Stage 1 re-derives against HEAD: the corpus, authority axis, and anchor-level precision Phase 9's draft steps assumed are all absent (A55.4, findings 146–148). This draft schedules what is buildable today and amends what is not (rule 7 / A12.4).
C-CALIBRATION.Problem:
D6's objective is sound and not in question: agent confidence is write-only, never gate- consumable, and exists only so a named consumer can later ask whether claims tracked outcomes. §9.4–§9.5 were written against a tree that does not exist at 4569196:
1. Gap 1 / finding 146. EpochOpened is not an event kind. KNOWN_KIND_STATE has opened (range allocation), not EpochOpened. run.xml carries <Epoch>1</Epoch> as a counter with no executor identity. A40.3's "mechanism is in place" row is false at HEAD. Step 9.5.4 over the live tree is 0 included, 0 excluded.
2. Gap 2 / finding 147. Authority (user-stated | tool-verified | agent-inferred) appears in decisions.md / plan.md / review*.md only. Zero matches under src/ and .ngrace/. The §9.5.2 separation rule's first half has no subject.
3. Gap 3 / finding 148. precision as an anchor field does not exist. exact | heuristic is exportConfidence on LanguageAnalysis (file-level adapter output), surfaced as analysis.heuristic-confidence. ANCHOR_PATTERNS are id shapes only; nothing attaches provenance to anchors. §9.4's two-field table names two fields neither of which lives on an anchor.
What is real and load-bearing: 15 AssertionKinds + evaluateAssertion; detached review with deterministic findingId; AbsenceValue degradation throughout the cursor; ReviewVerdictRecord (pass | fail | unable-to-determine, optional reason/note) with six <Verdict> entries across archived bundles. The second half of §9.5.2 (no gate reads claimedConfidence) is buildable today. An empty corpus is reportable, never fabricatable.
D16 / A46.4: a calibration report over nothing that presents as a table is both a check that has never failed and a path never observed succeeding. That is the failure mode this change exists to prevent.

Goals.Goal: claimedConfidence is a three-level ordinal enforced by grammar (D6 condition 5). Free text and percentages are rejected at write time.
claimedConfidence attaches only to claims an adjudicator will verdict (D6 condition 3). Free-floating narration cannot carry it.
claimedConfidence is write-only from the agent side (D6 condition 2). No gate under src/gates/ reads it. A real test fails when a gate starts reading the field.
Context features for the report are joined from ledger and bundle, not authored beside the claim (D6). Executor identity may be absent and lands as absence with a reason.

The calibration report is the named consumer (D6 condition 4). At N=0 it emits an honest empty/absence sentence with included and excluded counts, never a fabricated calibration table. Incomplete epochs are excluded as a class and counted.
Promotion bar is documented: claimedConfidence informs nothing today; held-out calibration per context class is required before any gate may consume it.
§9.5.2 first half (agent-inferred × precision) is amended as deferred absence with reasoning (rule 7 / A12.4), not silently reimplemented over a different subject while keeping the original heading.

New directory src/calibration/ is a governed module (MODULE_CONTRACT, export parity) with GraphAnchors ownership so change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope stays green — first live exercise of that rule on greenfield work since #30.

Constraints.Constraint: Spec only until planned and approved. This draft schedules work; it does not authorize production code (same shape as C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS / A51).

Phase 9 does not build D5's authority axis (user-stated | tool-verified | agent-inferred). That is an artifact-model expansion; §12.5 and A48's precedent (per-task scope not added to satisfy §8.5.4) settle it. If a check needs authority, the check is amended, not the authority model invented mid-phase.
An empty corpus is reported, never fabricated. No fixture-derived number may be presented as a calibration result over live project data (D6; A55.4).

Standing rule 12: every new check is run over this repository as it is; the flag count is recorded. A check that is red only because its subject does not exist is not ready under the original heading.
Standing rule 11: every sentence the calibration report emits must read true aloud given the inputs the run actually had — especially at N=0.

D14: calibration is a doctor / report consumer surface, not a fourth check surface. lint may enforce ordinal grammar and the no-gate-reads structural rule; gates never consult claimedConfidence; review does not emit calibration.* codes.
Invariant 5: additive only. Projects without claimedConfidence or without epochs lint clean.
Invariant 8 / F1: the binary writes only structural state it can derive or is explicitly given. Executor identity is harness-stated when supplied; ngrace does not invent it.
No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors stay byte-identical if skill text changes. Surgical diffs only.

D16: a check that has never failed is not a check. A46.4: a path never observed succeeding is not a path. Stage 2 must show the no-gate-reads test fail when a gate is deliberately made to read claimedConfidence, and must show the report path succeed at least once on a fixture with N≥1 labeled pairs (fixture numbers labeled as fixture, never as live calibration).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Building the authority axis (user-stated | tool-verified | agent-inferred) on anchors.
Attaching precision (exact | heuristic) to anchors, or renaming exportConfidence.
Consuming claimedConfidence in any gate, review audit, or agent context packet.
Presenting fixture tables as live calibration results, or inventing labeled pairs by back-filling archived bundles.
Phase 10 plan-quality signal, doctor §4.9 subset, or adoption walkthrough (Phases 10–11).
A separate marketplace release assignment (targets remain TBD).

Proposal.Question: Whether executor identity on epoch open is in Phase 9's scope or its own C-*.
Proposal.Recommendation: In Phase 9 as explicit enabling step 9.5.0 — extend the existing kind="opened" event with optional harness-stated executor identity (attribute or child), not invent a parallel EventKind "EpochOpened" that KNOWN_KIND_STATE does not know. Plan prose may keep the conceptual name EpochOpened; the on-disk kind stays opened. Absence when the host does not supply identity is D5-shaped (reason: host-capability-missing or equivalent). Rejected alternative: a freestanding C-EPOCH-OPENED that Phase 9 waits on — nothing else on the board schedules it, and building the report first re-creates A55.4 in round 2.
Proposal.Cost: Files: src/grace-cursor.ts (write + read of opened payload), cursor tests, skill note in ngrace-execute, possibly grammar validation of the optional field. Does not require a new KnownEventKind. One genuine opened-with-identity write path must be observed succeeding (A46.4). Does not by itself create labeled pairs — only the join key for context.

Proposal.Question: Where claimedConfidence attaches, and what stops free-floating narration.
Proposal.Recommendation: Attach as an optional attribute (or single child) on adjudicated claim surfaces that already carry an outcome the machinery will verdict: (1) attempt events — "this verification cycle claims pass/fail" is adjudicated by the attempt outcome and later review/apply; (2) optionally Verdict — "this change is clean" is adjudicated by ReviewVerdictRecord.outcome. Prefer attempt first (higher volume, already three-valued cycle log). Grammar admits claimedConfidence only on those elements; any other parent is a lint/grammar error. Free-floating narration has no element that accepts the attribute.
Proposal.Cost: Grammar + recordAttempt / recordReviewVerdict write paths; CLI flag on cursor attempt (and optionally gate verdict); skill one-liner. Does not require authority axis.

Proposal.Question: What the calibration report emits at N=0, N=1, and N small.
Proposal.Recommendation: N=0: no rate table. Emit included=0, excluded=<count of incomplete or non-pair epochs>, and a single absence-shaped sentence that a reader will hear as "no labeled pairs to calibrate" — never "perfect calibration" or empty buckets that look like 0% error. N=1: raw one-row observation (claimed level, adjudicated outcome, context class if derived); no percentage, no confidence interval, no "calibrated" word. N small (e.g. <20 complete pairs): counts per (claimed level × outcome) only; rates optional and labeled "descriptive count, not a calibration claim." Promotion / "calibration demonstrated" language is forbidden in the report until the promotion bar docs say otherwise — the report never self-certifies readiness for gate consumption.
Proposal.Cost: Branching in src/calibration/report.ts and doctor surface; unit tests for N=0/1/small; read-aloud fixtures. Cheap relative to inventing statistics.

Proposal.Question: How §9.5.2's separation rule is expressed given gaps 2 and 3.
Proposal.Recommendation: Amend §9.5.2 under rule 7 / A12.4: (a) first half deferred — "agent-inferred anchors may not carry precision" has zero subjects at HEAD (rule 12 count: 0 flags because 0 operands exist). Record as absence: separation rule half-1 not enforced — authority axis not in artifact model (see D5 cost, out of Phase 9). (b) second half ships — a unit or integration test that fails if any module under src/gates/ imports, reads, or pattern- matches claimedConfidence / claimed-confidence. Grep in the phase report is not the test; the test is. Standing rule 12 on half-2 at HEAD: 0 reads (correct; field absent).
Proposal.Cost: One amended verify sentence in the plan; one real test file asserting gate isolation. No lint code for agent-inferred×precision until authority exists.

Proposal.Question: How precision is treated; whether Phase 9 touches it; what §9.4's table means meantime.
Proposal.Recommendation: Phase 9 does not touch precision-on-anchors. exportConfidence remains file-level language analysis. §9.4's table stays as the design target for two non-merged fields; for this change only the claimedConfidence row is implemented. Docs (promotion bar + skill) state explicitly: precision column is CLI-derived instrument sharpness where it already exists (adapters); it is not yet an anchor attribute; claimedConfidence is the only new field.
Proposal.Cost: Documentation only for the precision half. Avoids a silent half-build that looks like D5 completed.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ORDINAL-SCALE: D6 condition 5 / step 9.5.1. claimedConfidence admits exactly three ordered levels (names fixed at plan time in stage 2; e.g. low | medium | high). Discriminating negatives: free text is rejected by the grammar or write path; a percentage string is rejected; a fourth level is rejected; omitting the field remains valid (additive, invariant 5).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ATTACHMENT-ADJUDICATED-ONLY: D6 condition 3 / A57 corr 149–150. claimedConfidence attaches on attempt as the claim site only. The join score is never the attempt outcome attribute; it is evaluateTargetComplete (adjudicator id target-assertions). Discriminating negatives: free text/percentages rejected on write; a pair whose adjudicatedOutcome equals only the agent-authored attempt outcome without an independent adjudicator is not a labeled pair; pending when target-assertions cannot produce a boolean (never silent fail); progress events have no claimedConfidence write path.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-GATE-READS: D6 condition 2 / step 9.5.2 second half. No code under src/gates/ reads claimedConfidence. Discriminating negative: a deliberate temporary import or property access of the field from a gate module makes the dedicated test red (mutation check); green suite alone is not the evidence. Standing rule 12 baseline at 4569196: 0 reads (field absent).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SEPARATION-HALF1-DEFERRED: Step 9.5.2 first half amended (rule 7). Plan and docs state that agent-inferred × precision is not enforced because authority is not an artifact concept at HEAD. Discriminating negatives: no lint code claims to enforce agent-inferred×precision; no issue code ships under that heading that is vacuously green on every tree (D16). Rule 12 count for a hypothetical half-1 check at HEAD: 0 flags / 0 subjects — recorded, not shipped as a check.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-DERIVED: D6 / step 9.5.3. Report context (task kind, adapter presence, wrote-vs-read, sequential-vs-parallel, completeness) is joined from ledger and bundle. Discriminating negatives: there is no authored context-class attribute required beside claimedConfidence; executor identity may be absent and surfaces as absence with a reason, never as a forged default model name.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPORT-N0: D6 condition 4 / step 9.5.4 / proposal P3. Over this repository (and any tree with no complete labeled pairs), the report prints included and excluded counts and an honest empty-corpus sentence. Discriminating negatives: it does not print a rate table that implies calibration; it does not say "100%" or "well calibrated"; it does not omit excluded incomplete epochs when any exist; read-aloud of the N=0 sentence is true.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPORT-EXCLUDES-INCOMPLETE: D6 bias safeguard / step 9.5.4. Incomplete epochs are a separate excluded class with a count. Discriminating negative: pooling complete and incomplete epochs into one rate is impossible in the public report API (or is a tested error).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-REPORT-FIXTURE-NOT-LIVE: A55.4 / D6. Fixture or unit-test labeled pairs may exercise the join; their numbers never appear as the project's live calibration result. Discriminating negative: doctor/CLI over the repo root with empty corpus still reports N=0 for live data even when tests elsewhere used fixtures with N>0.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PROMOTION-BAR: D6 condition 6 / step 9.5.5. Docs state claimedConfidence informs nothing today and what would have to be true for that to change (held-out calibration per context class). Discriminating negative: a reader of the skill or doctor help cannot find a sentence that says gates may use the field today.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-MODULE-GRAPH: New src/calibration/ is a module with MODULE_CONTRACT and exact export parity; graph gains M-CALIBRATION (or ratified name) with Path; plans that write those files include the module in GraphAnchors. Discriminating negatives: change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope fires if OWS lists src/calibration/report.ts without the anchor; MAP_MODE EXPORTS parity fails if the map lies.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-VALIDATE-CI: bun run validate:ci green after stage 2 implementation. Discriminating negative: typecheck, unit/integration, validate:cli, validate:marketplace all pass; root ngrace lint 0 errors.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Ordinal rejection tests; attachment-site tests (accepted on attempt/Verdict, rejected elsewhere); no-gate-reads mutation test red then green; N=0 report string read-aloud true on repo root; N=1 and small-N unit fixtures labeled as fixtures; incomplete-epoch exclusion counts; promotion-bar text present; GraphAnchors ownership for src/calibration/; root lint 0 errors; rule 12 counts recorded for every new check.

ReadAloud.N0Sentence: Calibration report: 0 labeled pairs included, 0 epochs excluded as incomplete. No adjudicated claims with claimedConfidence are available to score. claimedConfidence is not used by any gate.
ReadAloud.N0TruthConditions: True when the project has no complete epoch that both records claimedConfidence on an adjudicated claim and has a joinable outcome. At 4569196 this is the only honest live output: field absent, EpochOpened/executor identity absent, authority absent. A flatter sentence like "calibration: OK" or an empty table of rates would be false in the flattering direction (rule 11 / A46.3).
